title: Advertising aimed at children
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás MELLETT érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: All advertising aimed at children under twelve should be banned
candidateIdeas: Young children cannot tell the difference between an advertisement and real information.
Adverts make children nag their parents, which causes conflicts and stress in families.
Much of the advertising for children promotes unhealthy food and sugary drinks.
Adverts in games and videos collect children's data and manipulate them.
Sweden has banned TV advertising aimed at children under twelve for decades.
examinerArguments: Parents, not the state, should decide what their children watch and buy.
Advertising pays for free children's programmes, games and apps.
Children have to learn to deal with advertising, and a ban would only delay this.
A ban would be impossible to control on the internet and on social media.
Some adverts promote useful things, like books, educational toys or healthy habits.

followUpQuestions: Isn't it the parents' job, not the government's, to protect children from adverts?
Without advertising, who would pay for free children's programmes and apps?
How could anyone possibly control adverts on the internet?

usefulPhrases.hu: a gyerekek nyaggatással elért befolyása a szülők vásárlásaira

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Here's the statement: 'All advertising aimed at children under twelve should be banned.' What's your view?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'm completely in favour of a ban. Young children simply can't tell the difference between an advert and real information – my eight-year-old cousin genuinely believes that a certain cereal will make him stronger. On top of that, most adverts for kids promote sweets and sugary drinks, and they make children nag their parents, which causes a lot of conflict at home.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Isn't it the parents' job, not the government's, to protect children from adverts?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Parents do have a role, of course, but they can't be everywhere. Ads are hidden in games, videos and apps, and many of them also collect children's data. Parents can't fight huge companies on their own, so they need the law on their side.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Without advertising, who would pay for free children's programmes and apps?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That's a valid concern. However, Sweden has banned TV advertising aimed at children under twelve for decades, and Swedish children still have plenty of good programmes. Public service channels could fund quality content, and frankly, I'd rather pay a little than let my cousin be manipulated.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How could anyone possibly control adverts on the internet?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I admit it wouldn't be easy, and no ban is perfect. But platforms already know their users' ages very precisely, so they could be required to switch off ads for young users, with heavy fines if they don't. Even if it only partly worked, children would be far better protected than they are now.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: az álláspont (a tiltás mellett) végig világos, a vizsgázó a kapott ötletekből építkezik (unokatestvér-példa, egészségtelen ételek, adatgyűjtés), és mindhárom ellenvetésre reagál: elismeri a jogos részt, cáfol, a svéd példával bizonyít, végül megvalósítható megoldást javasol.

Szókincs: árnyalt egyetértő-ellentmondó fordulatok (Parents do have a role, of course, but …; That's a valid concern. However, …; I admit it wouldn't be easy) és a téma pontos szavai (nag their parents, manipulated, heavy fines).

Nyelvhelyesség: B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – nyomatékosító 'do' (Parents do have a role), Present Perfect (has banned … for decades), 'I'd rather … than …', szenvedő szerkezet (could be required to) és feltételes mondat.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I'm completely in favour of”, „they need the law on their side”, „That's a valid concern”, „Even if it only partly worked”.
